CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_esim_order_delivery()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO esim_private.order_runs(order_id,account_id,submission_ref,state)
 SELECT NEW.id,a.id,'esim_'||NEW.id::text,'prepared' FROM esim_private.accounts a WHERE a.account_key='primary';
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prune_esim_topup_discovery()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM esim_private.require_service();
 DELETE FROM esim_private.recharge_quotes WHERE expires_at<now()-interval '30 days';
 DELETE FROM esim_private.topup_cache WHERE requested_at<now()-interval '1 day';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_esim_catalogue_order()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('provider',c.provider,'bundle_name',c.bundle_name,
    'catalogue_details',c.catalogue_details,'countries',c.countries,
    'data_amount_mb',c.data_amount_mb,'duration_days',c.duration_days,
    'is_unlimited',c.is_unlimited,'retail_price_usd',NEW.retail_price_usd,
    'catalogue_observed_at',c.updated_at)
  INTO NEW.catalogue_snapshot FROM public.esim_offers_cache c
  WHERE c.provider=NEW.provider AND c.bundle_name=NEW.bundle_name;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
